Bios Setting EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> Lock Chipset -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> MSR Lock Control -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> EV DFX features -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> Disable BIOS Done -> [‘X’] EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> WHEA Error Injection Support -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> Whea PCIE Error Injection Action Table -> Enabled 2. source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- Socket 0~N (Intel I3C halt on Socket 0~N error injection): requires CScripts/EDKII unlock (Lock Chipset=Disable, MSR Lock Control=Disable, EV DFX Features=Enable, WHEA Error Injection Support=Enable) + the user/FAE to drive the Cscript/error-injection harness for this exact pattern. Agent captures the post-injection evidence with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -180 | grep -iE 'i3c|halt|bus.error'; echo __I3C_halt_on_Socket_0~N; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1".

test_case.purpose: Inject the approved I3C controller error on every supported socket/controller target and verify a deliberate hang with the platform-defined catastrophic/fatal BMC, UEFI, front-panel and LCD response, followed by bounded recovery.
required_package: Platform specification proving Intel/host LPSS I3C ownership or identifying the BMC/OOB controller instead
Socket 0~N to controller/LPSS/bus/endpoint map and coverage sequence
Maximum hang duration, exact catastrophic/fatal event codes and indicator/LCD applicability
Independent OOB console, backup, reset/recovery and BIOS restoration plan
test_case.test_command: The platform owner first proves I3C ownership, maps sockets to controller/LPSS instances and defines error code 0x13. A qualified FAE runs one injection per approved target with an armed OOB console and timer; an independent observer captures the hang and management-plane indications, then performs the approved recovery and restores settings.
test_case.expected_result: 1. System should hang 2. BMC error log should record catastrophic or fater error 3. Front Panel fault Light will Light if there is one 4. uEFI SEL Log should record catastrophic or fater error if there is one 5. If there is a LCD Panel, catastrophic or fater error information will be displayed

safety_gate: Dedicated idle SUT with stable power and independent BMC/serial observer
Do not treat a host-side LPSS injector as valid without explicit platform ownership proof
Run one mapped target at a time with a hard hang timeout and armed recovery
Stop on wrong controller, unexpected severity, missing management evidence or failed recovery
Never retry or reset autonomously; preserve evidence before recovery
expected_evidence: Approved ownership specification and SUT/socket/controller/LPSS/bus identity
Package hash, mapping matrix, exact commands and 0x13 definition
Pre/post BIOS settings and complete ITP transcript
Independent console hang timeline plus BMC/UEFI event codes and front-panel/LCD evidence
Recovery/reset transcript, restored health/settings and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: I3C is BMC/platform-management scope by default in this project. The Intel LPSS method requires an explicit platform-spec exception identifying controller, bus, endpoint and expected response; otherwise execution must remain stopped.

source_conflict.reason: Items requires Socket 0~N but the only command hardcodes socket=0/lpss=0; I3C ownership conflicts with the project BMC default unless explicitly overridden; 0x13 and `fater` are undefined; Windows conflicts with dmesg; and host SSH collection is infeasible during the required hang.
